scenarios.name: Use large ribbon commands and restore normal appearance

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
the full 3D Model ribbon uses the Compact appearance
the user selects "Large" from the Ribbon Appearance submenu
larger command icons appear in two rows without visible command labels
the user reopens the Ribbon Appearance submenu
the ribbon shows its mixed-size icons and command labels again
